nodes.label: Compact rail
nodes.rationale: The shell keeps its expanded outer width so the main column absorbs the freed 136px and grows left while its right edge stays put; desktop-only above 1000px because the mobile header and menu are a separate system.

nodes.label: Blob buddy component
nodes.rationale: Eyes stay the only facial feature so expression grows without changing the original 46px artwork; reduced motion, forced colors, hidden tabs, offscreen positions, and the Contact modal all pause the decorative motion.

nodes.label: Color tokens
nodes.rationale: blue-secondary use stays scoped to blue surfaces (contact panel, Shelf attribution) so the pale-blue treatment does not leak into every container.

nodes.label: Desktop compact rail component
nodes.rationale: Mode lasts for the session and survives client-side navigation but not a reload, because persistence was not part of the agreed behavior.

nodes.label: Magnetic contact controls
nodes.rationale: Magnetic travel is capped at 18 percent of the diameter and limited by the shorter dimension on the pill so the surface never escapes its target; decorative motion stops behind the modal to avoid competing with the dialog.

nodes.label: Shelf quote bubbles
nodes.rationale: A local extension approved 2026-10-26 that relates to the Blob buddy and contact panel without replacing site buttons or tooltips; the artwork reveal stays plain CSS so it responds before hydration.

nodes.label: Compact side menu component
nodes.rationale: Adapts Olivier Larose's Awwwards Side Menu but replaces its clip/perspective sequence with one 0.3s critical spring plus an inverse transform layer, because independent reveal timers made reversal and interruption feel discontinuous.

nodes.label: Typography roles
nodes.rationale: Geist carries interface and prose while Caveat marks personal notes only, keeping the handwriting signal meaningful.

nodes.label: Focus-ring clipping finding
nodes.rationale: At 200 percent text the scroll region clipped Home's top focus border, so 8px block-start padding, scroll padding, and target scroll margins were added because focus indicators must stay visible when keyboard navigation scrolls a control into view.

nodes.label: Mask and elevation split finding
nodes.rationale: When the popup owned both the reveal clip and the overflow mask, the close target sat flush against the clipped edge; moving the mask to an inner surface and shadow to an outer wrapper gives the control and its outline clearance.

nodes.label: Alan Sahlan website design system
nodes.rationale: Records the existing Home and About implementation rather than prescribing a future one; white space, dark text, restrained cobalt accents, and cover artwork carry the pages, with the Alan character and Blob buddy supplying playfulness.

nodes.label: Blob buddy interaction spec
nodes.rationale: Idle liveliness replaced the earlier pen.dev note to breathe twice and then rest; the approved 24px neutral zone and 240px response radius are a feel-test baseline, not measurements from the existing design.

nodes.label: Contact modal interaction spec
nodes.rationale: The reference's olive colors and the name Faiz are example content, not Alan's tokens or identity, so only the pattern is borrowed.

nodes.label: Lenis page scrolling spec
nodes.rationale: Motion is not added just to drive the frame loop because it only pays off with Motion scroll animations, and this site animates pointer input instead.

nodes.label: Compact desktop rail release entry
nodes.rationale: A non-negative frame delta guard keeps the spring from inverting when a frame timestamp predates the scheduling sample.

nodes.label: Greeting and desktop Shelf correction
nodes.rationale: Alan's screenshots showing a crowded greeting and a clipped final Shelf item override the prior visual-review conclusion for those states.

nodes.label: Mobile side menu interface review
nodes.rationale: Reviewed with better-interface plus all six owning skills; the review covers accessibility, layout, writing, typography, colors, and UI, and records implemented replacements rather than open findings.

nodes.label: Native pointer decision
nodes.rationale: Alan removed the sticky-cursor effect on 2026-10-26 while keeping the magnetic and gooey controls, so no cursor overlay or cursor-hiding rule may return.

nodes.label: --rail-progress shared spring value
nodes.rationale: One critically damped spring at a 0.36s response drives rail width, label widths, navigation padding, action alignment, character exit, and icon centering, so a mid-flight reversal keeps the live position and velocity instead of snapping.

nodes.label: Readable quotes and attribution
nodes.rationale: Keep quote, attribution and curved tail within narrow and short viewports, with keyboard/touch dismissal and static reduced motion.

nodes.label: Soft Shelf speech bubbles
nodes.rationale: Quotes feel like Shelf speaking through bubbles related to Blob buddy; replace rejected dark cards and accent lines.

nodes.rationale: Cited as the verifiable source that writes and re-adds the Next.js agent rules block.

nodes.label: next dev Command
nodes.rationale: Running the dev server is what injects the nextjs-agent-rules block into AGENTS.md.

nodes.label: Deprecation Notices Guidance
nodes.rationale: Heeding deprecation notices prevents agents from writing code against APIs this Next.js version is retiring.

nodes.label: nextjs-agent-rules Block
nodes.rationale: Generated and re-added automatically by next dev, so deleting it from a diff just recreates the uncommitted change while committing it keeps the tree clean.

nodes.label: This Is NOT The Next.js You Know
nodes.norm_label: this is not the next.js you know
nodes.rationale: The repo's Next.js version diverges from training data across APIs, conventions, and file structure, so guides must be read before writing code.

nodes.label: node_modules/next/dist/docs Guides
nodes.rationale: Local package docs are the authoritative reference for this Next.js version, and the path resolves from the file's directory because the package may not be visible from a monorepo root.
